description: This file defines the 'Arn' class for handling Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) in AWS SDK for PHP. It provides parsing, validation, and retrieval methods for ARNs, encapsulating their structure and components.

classes.name: Arn
classes.description: Represents an AWS ARN, with methods to parse, validate, and access ARN components.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an ARN string into its component parts (arn, partition, service, region, account_id, resource).

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an Arn object from an array or string, performing validation.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the ARN.

methods.name: getPartition
methods.description: Returns the partition component of the ARN.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Returns the service component of the ARN.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Returns the region component of the ARN.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns the resource part of the ARN.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the ARN components as an associative array.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs basic validation on the components of an ARN.

methods.name: isValidHostLabel
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid host label for ARN components.
